## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `a2f2be9c0aee03257f9bef63007426bfebd99c73`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-api/evals/endpoints-auth-routes.json + packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts (`META_LIST_QUERY_PARAMS`, `metaListUnknownParamRefusal`, `NAMES_ON_PACKAGE_LIST_MESSAGE`, `metaListNames`, `createMetaListAnswer` step 2a/8), packages/rest/src/meta-collection-routes.ts (the `GET /api/v1/meta/:type` handler), packages/rest/src/meta-query-arity-doors.test.ts, packages/rest/src/meta-list-names-filter.test.ts, packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts (`GetMetaItemsRequestSchema.names`), skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md + rules/datasources.md + rules/security.md + references/_index.md, skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md (Driver Selection Guide), skills/objectstack-data/evals/README.md (the eval convention), packages/skills/package.json, scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs (the ceiling row)

Inputs read: card #30710 (body, triage, claim, os-dev-report); PR #30844 body and three-file list; the net diff `origin/main...a2f2be9c` (merge-base `b6182249`); the check-runs on the head. The cited code was read on `origin/main` through git objects, nothing built or run.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept set: no runtime, schema or route file changes. The diff is prose (`skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md`), one eval fixture, one changeset. Right: the PR body claims no behaviour change and the tree agrees.
- Public surface: `skills/**` ships as `@objectstack/skills` (`packages/skills/package.json`, the catalog sync), so the new Metadata API paragraph and the three deletions ARE a published-text change — correctly carried by the changeset. Right.
- Governed path: `skills/**` is Tier H (AGENTS.md governed list); the PR is a draft awaiting a governed approver, and `Governed Surface Queue Guard` is green on the head. Right.
- Ratchet: `check-skills-token-ratchet` ceiling row for `skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md` (6314) is untouched by the diff; the body's 5144 → 5141 reading is consistent with a 446 → 441-line file, and `Lint · repo & tooling gates` is green. Right.
- Dispatch surface respected: only the one skill file, one eval case, one changeset; no other skill, no ceiling moved. Right.
- Check-runs on the head at review time: every concluded run is `success` (Lint x8 incl. CI/release/engine gates, Type Check x5, Build Core, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, Dogfood Regression Gate, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Test Core (2/8), Test UI, Live E2E UI, Auto Label, filter); only `Test Core (1/8)` was still `in_progress` at the last read. The diff carries no runtime code, so that shard cannot read it; the adopting seat re-reads it before ACCEPT. No run is red.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/30710-meta-list-names-filter.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`. Right — a documentation change to a published skill text, no API surface of any `@objectstack/*` runtime package moves. `Check Changeset` green.
- `Clause-②: no` on the PR body and the changeset, no `(narrowing)` arm. Right — the skill text describes a narrowing that PR #30709 already declared on its own changeset (ruling 6580261740 letter A: "the seat states it on the changeset"); this PR takes nothing away at any consumer.
- `Metadata-protocol: none`. Right — an API query key is not authorable metadata.
- Face: governed rules text (`skills/**`) ⇒ `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`; the record's tier matches `--paths`.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: `[]` — nothing to answer.
- Dev flag "Eval case 7 … the seat may drop it": answered below (④) — keep it, with one should-fix on its assertions; dropping it is also within the dispatch surface ("at most one evals/*.json case").
- Dev flag "skills/objectstack-api/evals/ has no runner script in this repo": confirmed — the fixtures are population 1b of `check-skills-token-ratchet` (measured, not ratcheted) and `skills/README.md` calls them maintainer-scored. Not a defect; no escalation.
- Dev note "OS_SKIP_DTS=1 reds check:dual-build-cjs-loads": a local-build trap already named in AGENTS.md; no card owed. Not escalated.
- Serial constraint from the claim (merge `origin/main` before pushing): the merge-base is `b6182249`, which was `origin/main` at push time; `origin/main` has since moved to `25e1c1ad` with no touch to the two `hits` files. Nothing to redo.

### ④ Design judgment

**`skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md` — the new Metadata API paragraph against `main`'s code.** Every claim checked and held:

- Closed query set `package`, `preview`, `object`, `include`, `id`, `names`, `locale` — equals `META_LIST_QUERY_PARAMS` (meta-item-read-gate.ts:2659) and the pin `SUPPORTED_LIST_PARAMS` (meta-query-arity-doors.test.ts:292).
- "refuses any other key with `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` instead of ignoring it" — `metaListUnknownParamRefusal` (meta-item-read-gate.ts:2705) returns `{ status: 400, code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', rule: 'unknown-parameter' }`; the RestServer door asks it first, before any protocol read (meta-collection-routes.ts:666; pinned by "an undeclared key answers the nested 400 before any protocol read", and by `name`, `ids`, `filter`, `names[]` each refused).
- "`?names=a,b,c` (one comma-separated value)" — `metaListNames` splits one string on `,`, trims, drops blanks, dedupes (meta-item-read-gate.ts:2750); a repeated key is refused by the arity door (`META_QUERY_ARITY_DOORS.list` carries `names`). Matches the ruling's letter A spelling.
- "narrows the list to the named items the caller may see" — chain step 2a runs after THE per-caller list gate (step 2) and before the mask and translation (meta-item-read-gate.ts:4090–4098); pinned in meta-list-names-filter.test.ts.
- "an unknown name is simply absent" — `names: 'account,nope'` → `['account']`, `names: 'nope'` → `ok: true, []` (meta-list-names-filter.test.ts); never a 404.
- "an empty value is refused `400`" — `''`, `','`, `' , '` each throw `status: 400, code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', param: 'names'` (meta-item-read-gate.ts:2753–2765; pinned); the route asks `metaListNames` before the store read (meta-collection-routes.ts:729).
- "the `package` list (keyed by id) refuses the key" — `NAMES_ON_PACKAGE_LIST_MESSAGE`, `rule: 'names-on-package'` (meta-item-read-gate.ts:2712–2714, 2727); pinned on both transports.
- "These are **client** contracts — nothing in a stack declares them" — kept from `main`; still true (no Zod authoring surface declares list query keys; `GetMetaItemsRequestSchema.names` is the protocol request, not stack metadata).
- Against the card's eval prompt: an agent reading the paragraph now knows the one-request spelling and that a misspelt filter is refused, which is the exact gap the card names.

**The three deletions — does any rule lose its only home?**

- "Data CRUD lives under the `/data` prefix" + the `groupBy`/`aggregations` spelling: the route block directly above (SKILL.md:40–52) lists every `/data` path, and the derived-operations table row `aggregate` → `POST /data/{object}/query` with `groupBy`/`aggregations` (SKILL.md:266 in the PR tree) keeps the spelling. The negative pins (no `/bulk`, no `GET .../aggregate`) survive, and eval case 5 still has its `/batch` anchor. Nothing lost.
- `## Datasources`: `defineDatasource`/`schemaMode`/`external`/`credentialsRef` are taught in skills/objectstack-data/rules/datasources.md (lines 3, 9, 47, 65–71); the Driver Selection Guide with the Turso Cloud/EE caveat is skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md:197–207; `data/driver/config-registry.zod.ts` is skills/objectstack-data/references/_index.md:30. The Skill Boundaries table gains the rule-file name and a `Pick a driver package` row, so every pointer the section carried still routes. No frame, gate or `references/_index.md` of objectstack-api names the `## Datasources` heading. Nothing lost.
- `(`definePermissionSet`)`, ", not this one": `definePermissionSet` is taught in skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md:9–11, 77; the routing sentence "RBAC and RLS are objectstack-data's surface" stays. Nothing lost.

**Should-fix 1 (SKILL.md:71–72).** The parentheticals read as the value set, and `include` (`content`) omits `grants`: the list also reads `?include=grants` on the `position` list (chain step 8, meta-item-read-gate.ts:4041, 4168; `describeMetaPositionList`). A reader who takes the parenthetical as closed will spell `?include=grants` as a refused key. `main` carried the same omission, so this is not a regression, but the new sentence now asserts a CLOSED set and so invites that reading. Cheapest fix: "`include` (`content`, `grants`)" — three tokens, inside headroom.

**`skills/objectstack-api/evals/endpoints-auth-routes.json` — case 7 against the convention and against `main`.**

- Shape: `id`, `prompt`, `expected_output`, `files: []`, `assertions.must_contain` / `must_not_contain` — matches cases 1–6 and the objectui shape the data evals README names. JSON parses; `check-skills-token-ratchet` measures, never ratchets, population 1b.
- Against `main`: `GET /api/v1/meta/object?names=account,contact,lead` is what the route serves (type `object` is the folded singular the tests drive; the names filter answers `['account','contact','lead']` on the fixture `OBJECTS` the pin uses). `must_not_contain` `?name=`, `?ids=`, `?filter=` are the three undeclared spellings the arity-doors test refuses; `?names=` does not contain the substring `?name=` (the `s` precedes `=`), so the negative assertion cannot bite the right answer. A `/api/v1/meta/objects?...` spelling still contains `/api/v1/meta/object`, so the plural does not fail the anchor.
- **Should-fix 2 (endpoints-auth-routes.json:68–70).** `must_contain` requires the literal `VALIDATION_ERROR`, but the prompt asks only to collapse three reads into one request. A correct, complete answer (`GET /api/v1/meta/object?names=account,contact,lead`, unknown name absent, empty value 400) that never names the misspelt-filter refusal fails the eval. The data evals README's rule is one specific SKILL.md rule per case; case 7 scores two (the filter and the closed set) and anchors the second through a token the prompt gives no reason to produce. Either drop `VALIDATION_ERROR` from `must_contain` (keep it in `expected_output`), or give the prompt the hook (e.g. "our first attempt, `?name=account`, came back 400 — why?"). The dev already offered to drop the case; dropping is acceptable too, but the fixed case is worth keeping because it is the only eval that exercises the Metadata API section.

**Nit (not a finding).** The Skill Boundaries row now reads "datasources (`rules/datasources.md`)" in the Need column; the deleted section spelled it "objectstack-data → `rules/datasources.md`". objectstack-api has no `rules/` directory, so a reader may look for the file locally; the row's Use-instead cell does name objectstack-data, so the routing survives.

No must-fix. The paragraph states nothing the code does not pin, the deletions orphan no rule, and the eval case is inside the fixture's convention apart from the one over-tight assertion.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-is2e6b`
Reviewed-by: `session_01L9qibz5RLVEYDFco93jZ7u`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `1403468afe798e3c63744bc743e7f4d2f32b287c`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-api/evals/endpoints-auth-routes.json + packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts (`META_LIST_QUERY_PARAMS`, chain step 8 `?include=grants`), content/docs/releases/v17/17-0.mdx and content/docs/protocol/kernel/http-protocol.mdx (the `enable.trash` retirement's homes), .changeset/30237-recycle-bin-snapshot-on-delete.md on `origin/main` (PR #30780, the recycle-bin write side)

Delta review: one commit `1403468a` on top of `a2f2be9c`, applying the two should-fixes of the record at PR comment 6678765634, which this record supersedes. Everything that record judged and the delta does not touch stands as written there (the seven-key set, the `?names=` semantics, the three deletions, the changeset, `Clause-②: no`). Inputs: the delta diff `git diff a2f2be9c 1403468a` (two files, no changeset change), the check-runs on `1403468a`, the cited code on `origin/main` read through git objects; nothing built or run.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept set: unchanged — still prose and one eval fixture; no runtime, schema or route file.
- Public surface: the published skill text changes by one added value name (`grants`) and one dropped parenthetical; still a `@objectstack/skills` patch. Right.
- Dispatch surface: still the one skill file and the one eval case; no ceiling row moved; the growth is paid in the same file (the parenthetical is longer than the two added tokens). Right.
- Check-runs on `1403468a`: every concluded run `success` (Lint x9 incl. `Lint & Repo Gates`, which carries the token ratchet; Type Check x5; Build Core; Check Changeset; Check PR Size; Dogfood Regression Gate; Governed Surface Queue Guard; PR-body guards; Test Core (2/8); Test UI; Live E2E UI; Auto Label; filter); only `Test Core (1/8)` still `in_progress` at the last read. No runtime code in the diff; the adopting seat re-reads that shard before ACCEPT. No run is red.

### ② Semver level

- Unchanged: `.changeset/30710-meta-list-names-filter.md`, `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. The delta adds no surface and takes none away. Right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Both should-fixes of 6678765634 are addressed in the tree (④ judges how). No new dev flag, no `open_questions`.
- Serial: the merge-base is still `b6182249`; `origin/main` has since taken #30780 (`25e1c1ad`), which touches no `skills/**` file, so no textual conflict. Its changeset bears on a sentence the delta re-wraps; see ④.

### ④ Design judgment

**SKILL.md:72 — `include` (`content`, `grants`).** Holds: the list chain's step 8 reads `?include=grants` on the `position` list (meta-item-read-gate.ts:4041, 4168) and step 6 reads `?include=content` on `doc`; `include` is one key of `META_LIST_QUERY_PARAMS` (meta-item-read-gate.ts:2659). The parenthetical now names both values the list reads, so the closed-set sentence no longer invites a reader to spell a served value as a refused key. Should-fix 1 of 6678765634 is met.

**SKILL.md:411–413 — the dropped `enable.trash` parenthetical.** Does the rule lose its only home? No: the retirement is taught in content/docs/releases/v17/17-0.mdx:154–155 (`restore` / `purge` never derive — `enable.trash` retired) and :1045 (`object.enable.trash` / `enable.mru`, ADR-0049 close-out, #2377), and in content/docs/protocol/kernel/http-protocol.mdx:798 ("removed in v17"). Both homes say **v17**; the deleted parenthetical said **16.x**, so the deletion removes a mis-dated statement and keeps nothing a reader needs. The pitfall's rule (hard delete; recover through `trackHistory` or a `lifecycle` archive policy) stays, and eval case 5's anchors (`trackHistory`, `lifecycle`, no `'restore'`) still read it.

**Should-fix 3 (SKILL.md:412, carried from main — not charged to this PR).** The re-wrapped sentence now stands alone as "there is no recycle bin." On `origin/main` since `25e1c1ad` (PR #30780, ADR-0148 write side) a by-id delete of a business record writes a `sys_recycle_bin` entry; the delete is still physical, no read path changed and no restore door ships, so "`DELETE` is a hard delete" and the recovery advice remain true for a caller, but "there is no recycle bin" is now literally false. #30780's own changeset declares `Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md :268, :417 (they teach that there is no recycle bin)`, so that correction is a separately owed card, not this PR's debt, and this PR's merge-base predates it. Not a must-fix: the delta changes no meaning of the sentence, and the owed follow-up has a declared owner. The seat should make sure that follow-up card exists before this PR's text is read as the newest word on the subject; if the dev prefers, "there is no recycle bin" can be dropped here too (the sentence "ObjectStack `DELETE` is a hard delete." carries the pitfall alone), which is a one-clause deletion inside the dispatch surface.

**endpoints-auth-routes.json:66 — the prompt's refused-filter hook.** The prompt now says "our `?name=account,contact,lead` attempt came back 400", so a complete answer explains the refusal (closed set, `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`) and `must_contain: ["VALIDATION_ERROR"]` is reachable from the prompt. Against `main`: `?name=` on the `object` list IS refused `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` before any protocol read (meta-query-arity-doors.test.ts: "an undeclared `name` is refused … with the located sentence"; "RestServer: an undeclared key answers the nested 400"), so the scenario the prompt states is what the server serves. Should-fix 2 of 6678765634 is met.

**Should-fix 4 (endpoints-auth-routes.json:66 with :71).** The same hook creates a scoring tension: the prompt now contains the literal `?name=`, and `must_not_contain` still forbids `?name=` in the output. A natural correct answer quotes the caller's attempt ("your `?name=` key is outside the closed set, so it was refused") and would fail the negative assertion while being exactly right. Either (a) drop `?name=` from `must_not_contain` (keep `?ids=`, `?filter=`, which the prompt never mentions), or (b) phrase the prompt without the literal ("our attempt with a singular `name` key came back 400"). Not a must-fix: the fixture has no runner in this repo and is maintainer-scored, and the positive anchors are right; but the case should not punish the answer the prompt itself invites.

No must-fix. The two requested fixes land as asked and hold against the code; the dropped parenthetical had two homes that also correct its date; the one carried-over stale clause is #30780's declared follow-up.

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `4138810d643efa39d1f6be0267d27f22900459a2`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-api/evals/endpoints-auth-routes.json + packages/rest/src/meta-query-arity-doors.test.ts (the `name` / `ids` / `filter` refusal pins the eval case rests on), the merge-base `677d542a` of `origin/main` (to read the net diff)

Second delta review: two commits on top of `1403468a` — `fa02fd0f` (eval case 7's `must_not_contain` drops `?name=`, keeps `?ids=` and `?filter=`) and `4138810d`, a merge of `origin/main` `677d542a`. This record supersedes the one at PR comment 6679015536 (head `1403468a`); everything that record and its predecessor (6678765634) judged and this delta does not touch stands as written there. Inputs: `git diff 1403468a 4138810d -- skills/ .changeset/`, `git diff --name-status origin/main...4138810d`, the check-runs on `4138810d`, the cited pins on `origin/main` read through git objects; nothing built or run.

### ① Derived judgments

- The two-point delta `1403468a..4138810d` under `skills/` and `.changeset/` holds exactly one PR-authored hunk — the `must_not_contain` line of eval case 7 — plus three changesets that arrive through the merge (`30237-recycle-bin-snapshot-on-delete.md`, `30512-plugin-approvals-locales-b.md`, `30692-field-group-requires-feature.md`), each byte-identical to `origin/main`'s. Right: the merge adds nothing to what the PR publishes.
- Net diff against `origin/main` (merge-base `677d542a`): `.changeset/30710-meta-list-names-filter.md` (A), `skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md` (M), `skills/objectstack-api/evals/endpoints-auth-routes.json` (M) — the same three files as every earlier head. Right.
- Accept set and public surface: unchanged from 6679015536 — prose, one eval fixture, one `@objectstack/skills` patch changeset; no runtime, schema or route file. Dispatch surface respected. Right.
- Check-runs on `4138810d`: every concluded run `success` (Lint x9 incl. `Lint & Repo Gates`, Type Check x5, Build Core, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, Dogfood Regression Gate, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Test Core (2/8), Test UI, Live E2E UI, Auto Label, filter); only `Test Core (1/8)` still `in_progress` at the last read. No runtime code in the diff; the adopting seat re-reads that shard before ACCEPT. No run is red.

### ② Semver level

- Unchanged: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. The merged-in changesets belong to their own PRs, already on `main`, and are not this PR's declaration. Right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Should-fix 4 of 6679015536 is addressed in the tree (④). No new dev flag, no `open_questions`.
- Should-fix 3 of 6679015536 (SKILL.md:412 "there is no recycle bin", stale since #30780) is unchanged in this delta and stays what it was: a carried claim whose correction #30780's changeset declares as its own owed `Skills-docs` follow-up (`:268, :417`). Not this PR's debt; the seat sees that card filed. The merge now puts that changeset in the PR's own tree, so the owed follow-up is visible from the branch too.
- Serial: the merge brings the branch to `origin/main` `677d542a`; no textual conflict in `skills/**` (no merged commit touches it).

### ④ Design judgment

**endpoints-auth-routes.json:71 — `must_not_contain: ["?ids=", "?filter="]`.** Should-fix 4 is met: the prompt (line 66) quotes the caller's refused `?name=account,contact,lead` attempt, and the negative assertions no longer forbid the literal the prompt invites the answer to quote. The two remaining spellings, `?ids=` and `?filter=`, are names the prompt never mentions and that `main` refuses as undeclared (meta-query-arity-doors.test.ts: `it.each(['name', 'ids', 'filter', …])` refused with the located sentence), so an answer that recommends either is wrong and is caught; an answer that explains why `?name=` failed is right and no longer penalised. The positive anchors (`?names=`, `/api/v1/meta/object`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`) are each reachable from the prompt and each pinned on `main`. The case now tests the one rule the card names (the `?names=` filter and the closed set that refuses its misspellings) with the positive and negative patterns the data evals README asks for.

Nothing else in the two `hits` files moved between `1403468a` and `4138810d`; the judgments of 6678765634 and 6679015536 on the Metadata API paragraph, the three same-file deletions, the `include` (`content`, `grants`) fix and the dropped `enable.trash` parenthetical stand.

No must-fix. No new should-fix. Should-fix 3 remains an owed follow-up of #30780, not a finding against this diff.

domain:skills#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibz5RLVEYDFco93jZ7u

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`objectstack-api` 技能的 Metadata API 一段补上 `/api/v1/meta/:type` 列表的两点：`?names=a,b,c` 只返回点名的条目（一个逗号分隔的值；不存在的名字不返回；空值 400；`?package=` 包列表不接受它），以及列表只认七个查询参数（`package`、`preview`、`object`、`include`（`content`、`grants`）、`id`、`names`、`locale`），其他任何键都 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`。测试题加第 7 题（一次 `?names=` 读三个对象）。
- 为什么改：PR #30709 已在 main 上提供 `?names=` 并关闭了查询参数集，但技能没写，AI 会按名字逐个请求，或拼错参数后以为拿到了全量列表。
- 风险与回滚：只改技能文本、一道测试题和 changeset，不碰运行时。篇幅靠同文件删重复/过时内容换来（`/data` 前缀一句、Datasources 一节并入 Skill Boundaries 表、`definePermissionSet` 旁注、一个写错版本号的 `enable.trash` 括注），token 5144→5131，上限 6314 未动。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md` 第 71–72 行。
- 两分钟验证：`git grep -n "names=" skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md packages/rest/src/meta-list-names-filter.test.ts`。
- 需要你做的：改的是 `skills/**`，属于 Tier H，需要 os-zhuang（或 hotlong）批准后才能合并。契约复审 PASS 记录 6679200681，Head-sha `4138810d`。

席位意见：契约复审三轮都 PASS，四条建议修改里三条已改，第四条（SKILL.md 第 412 行“没有回收站”已过时）是 #30780 留下的欠账，已有卡 #30847 跟进。可以批准。

## 席位核对
**ACCEPT** · seat `domain:skills#2` · head `4138810d` · 2026-11-06T07:05Z

1. **Shape:** `Fixes #30710`, draft, base `main`, 3 files (`skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md`, `skills/objectstack-api/evals/endpoints-auth-routes.json` case 7, `.changeset/30710-meta-list-names-filter.md` `'@objectstack/skills': patch`), +33/−20, five commits (two fix commits, merges of `origin/main`).
